evals.prompt: Review this harness pack. specs/demo.yaml has name: demo and templateMetadata.name: demo, but validators/demo-static.json asserts template.json name equals my-template. The yarn validator's first command is named yarn-install instead of install. Contract is uncommented but validator.enabled is missing. PRD contains 'C1' and a howToVerify paragraph copied from the contract. Produce a blocker-oriented review.
evals.expected_output: A review report flagging name mismatch, missing install command name, Tier 3 misconfiguration (contract without validator.enabled), and oracle-integrity failure (contract text in PRD).

assertions.name: flags-install-name
assertions.description: Flags missing literal install command name

assertions.name: flags-tier3-incomplete
assertions.description: Flags Tier 3 needing both contract and validator.enabled

assertions.name: flags-oracle-leak
assertions.description: Flags contract assertion text leaking into the PRD

evals.prompt: Audit whether this pack is safe to enable chainValidation. Spec has contract + validator.enabled, chainValidation.enabled true, network: mainnet, and one assertion with executableWithTestSigner true. Playwright smoke lists deep UX steps that belong in the contract. Report findings.
evals.expected_output: Blocker for network mainnet; warning that Playwright is too thick; confirmation that executableWithTestSigner requires chainValidation (present) but network must be testnet.

assertions.name: flags-thick-playwright
assertions.description: Warns that deep UX belongs in Tier 3 not Playwright

evals.prompt: Check skills: list on specs/demo.yaml which includes hedera-consensus-service and harness-spec-author. Is that correct?
evals.expected_output: Warn that harness-spec-author must not be vendored into generator runs; hedera-consensus-service is fine.

assertions.name: rejects-author-in-skills
assertions.description: Calls out harness-spec-author in skills list

assertions.name: explains-audience
assertions.description: Explains authoring vs generator audience split
